purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 794 Youyi (city code 10464); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: Primary Dalian Jinpu New Area government pages identify Youyi Subdistrict (友谊街道) as a local administrative unit and identify the Jinpu Real Estate Registration Center’s local registration work. This resolves the WUP name as Youyi Subdistrict in Jinpu, Dalian, rather than a different settlement called Youyi. The available evidence is a local registry/administrative match; it does not independently locate the exact WUP centroid inside a cadastral coverage boundary.

officialSources.observation: Jinpu government identifies Youyi Subdistrict (友谊街道), its local government office and subdistrict administrative remit.
